digest.component_or_area: mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: Historical mutation test score ceilings for signing.py and other modules are stale; pinned mutmut 3.7.0 detects 814 mutants in signing.py versus old record of 491, including real contract gaps and equivalent survivors that cannot be bulk-normalized.

Enforce mutation quality through manifest-authoritative per-shard modes (advisory, ratchet, strict) with explicit promotion criteria: advisory gathers evidence, ratchet preserves unchanged legacy survivors and blocks regressions, strict requires all mutants killed or individually fingerprinted.

Selector derives per-shard matrix jobs from changed source/test/support files, each shard job has a 30-minute cap, fresh isolated archives with no cached verdicts, and pinned mutmut 3.7.0 with max-children=1 and explicit per-mutant timeout values.

Ratchet mode compares fresh base/head archives and permits AST-identical functions to preserve unchanged legacy survivors and no-tests outcomes; added or edited functions must kill every mutant unless individually reviewed as equivalent.
Strict mode requires every mutant to be killed or individually fingerprinted as equivalent; no-tests, timeouts, incomplete status, and zero-mutant runs block promotion to strict.
Documentation contract validates phased policy, promotion evidence, manifest authority, CI cadence, and false-positive handling; stale score/budget tables must be removed.
